question: nearest country to 0 0
sql: WITH pt AS (SELECT ST_Point(0,0) AS geom) SELECT c.name, c.iso_a3, ST_Distance_Sphere(pt.geom, c.geometry) AS dist_m FROM countries c, pt ORDER BY dist_m LIMIT 1

question: 3 closest rivers to Brazil
sql: WITH country_geom AS (SELECT geometry FROM countries WHERE name = 'Brazil' LIMIT 1) SELECT r.name AS river_name, r.feature_class, ST_Distance_Sphere(r.geometry, c.geometry) AS dist_m FROM rivers r, country_geom c WHERE r.geometry IS NOT NULL ORDER BY dist_m LIMIT 3

question: closest country pair in Europe
sql: WITH eu AS (SELECT iso_a3, name, geometry FROM countries WHERE continent = 'Europe') SELECT a.name AS country_a, b.name AS country_b, ST_Distance_Sphere(a.geometry, b.geometry) AS dist_m FROM eu a JOIN eu b ON a.iso_a3 < b.iso_a3 ORDER BY dist_m LIMIT 1

question: nearest river per African country
sql: SELECT c.name AS country, r.name AS nearest_river, ST_Distance_Sphere(c.geometry, r.geometry) AS dist_m FROM countries c CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT r2.name, r2.geometry FROM rivers r2 WHERE r2.geometry IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ST_Distance_Sphere(c.geometry, r2.geometry) LIMIT 1) r WHERE c.continent = 'Africa' ORDER BY c.name LIMIT 50

question: countries within 500km of Nile
sql: WITH nile AS (SELECT ST_Union_Agg(geometry) AS geom FROM rivers WHERE name ILIKE '%Nile%') SELECT c.name, c.iso_a3, ST_Distance_Sphere(c.geometry, n.geom) AS dist_m FROM countries c, nile n WHERE ST_Distance_Sphere(c.geometry, n.geom) <= 500000 ORDER BY dist_m

question: river closest to Vatican
sql: WITH vatican AS (SELECT geometry FROM countries WHERE name = 'Vatican' LIMIT 1) SELECT r.name, r.feature_class, ST_Distance_Sphere(v.geometry, r.geometry) AS dist_m FROM rivers r, vatican v WHERE r.geometry IS NOT NULL ORDER BY dist_m LIMIT 1
